ابتكرتن (form VIII)
# اِبْتَكَرْتُنَّ (ibtakartunna) /ib.ta.kar.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# اُبْتُكِرْتُنَّ (ubtukirtunna) /ub.tu.kir.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
